text_block_list.text:
Thunderous cheers erupted from the stands 
at Matikanetannhauser's victory!

Dedicating the long-awaited victory to the 
crowd—the Arima Kinen came to a close.

Stepping out of the Nakayama Racecourse 
entrance, she is cheered on by a young 
Umamusume she has never seen before.

"I'm the slowest and least talented in my 
club, but I won't give up! Because 
Machitan tried her best too!" Machikane 
Tannhauser felt a gradual swell of joy 
from those words.

"I managed to become her protagonist, 
after all." Murmuring those words, he 
watched the small figure walk away into 
the distance.
